note: Problem taxonomy used to PLANT problems in the corpus. Rule implementations (Stage 1c+) must use these ids. 'kind': syntactic = needs SQL only; schema = needs pasted DDL.

rules.name: select_star
rules.description: SELECT list contains * or alias.* (top level or subquery). SELECT * inside EXISTS(...) and COUNT(*) are NOT flagged.

rules.name: function_on_filtered_column
rules.description: A column is wrapped in a function/expression (YEAR, CONVERT, UPPER, ISNULL, arithmetic...) inside a WHERE or JOIN ON comparison, making it non-sargable. A function applied only to the constant/parameter side is NOT flagged.

rules.name: not_in_subquery
rules.description: NOT IN (subquery). NOT IN with a literal list is NOT flagged.

rules.name: distinct_with_join
rules.description: SELECT DISTINCT in a query that also contains a JOIN (possible masking of row multiplication). Heuristic.

rules.name: or_across_columns
rules.description: WHERE has OR between predicates on DIFFERENT columns. OR on the same column (should be IN) is NOT flagged.

rules.name: scalar_subquery_in_select
rules.description: A correlated scalar subquery in the SELECT list.

rules.name: order_by_in_subquery
rules.description: A derived table or CTE body uses TOP 100 PERCENT ... ORDER BY (the ORDER BY has no effect). Top-level ORDER BY, and ORDER BY with a real TOP n or OFFSET, are NOT flagged. (A bare ORDER BY in a derived table is a T-SQL syntax error, so it is not planted.)

rules.name: missing_join_condition
rules.description: A join with no predicate relating the two tables: comma-join with no linking predicate, or JOIN ... ON whose condition does not reference both sides. Explicit CROSS JOIN is deliberate and NOT flagged.

rules.name: implicit_conversion
rules.description: NEEDS SCHEMA. A column is compared with a value or column of incompatible type so the COLUMN side is implicitly converted (e.g. VARCHAR column vs N'' literal or numeric literal). Literal-side conversion (e.g. string literal vs DATETIME column) is NOT flagged.

rules.name: not_in_nullable_column
rules.description: NEEDS SCHEMA. NOT IN (subquery) where the subquery's selected column is nullable. Fires IN ADDITION to QT003.

rules.name: join_on_non_unique_key
rules.description: NEEDS SCHEMA. Equi-join where the join columns on neither side cover a PRIMARY KEY or UNIQUE constraint of their table (rows can multiply). Heuristic; legitimate many-to-many joins will be flagged.
